note: The five looks. Each is a stack of tune-only slots in grade_math units (temp, tint, con, sat, mat; see
../boards/grade-board/grade_math.json), so a look is the same maths on the Grade Board and in the bake.
No look uses a LUT file. 'none' (the identity) is not listed: it is the empty stack, and there is no default
look. strength 0-1 scales every tune number linearly, so strength 0 is the identity and 1 is the look as
written. neutral: true marks a look that removes colour on purpose; the skin guard checks only skin

looks.name: Natural
looks.why: a touch of contrast and colour, nothing you'd notice as a look

looks.name: Soft matte
looks.why: lifted blacks, softer contrast, calmer colour

looks.name: Mono
looks.why: black and white with a little contrast
